headline: 9 Bangladeshis killed in Kolkata hotel fire
summary: A journalist from Kushtia and his family members are among the victims of a devastating blaze at a budget hotel in central Kolkata.
details: A devastating fire broke out around 2 AM on Wednesday at a five-story building on Mirza Ghalib Street near New Market in Kolkata. Nine Bangladeshis, including a four-year-old child, were killed in the tragedy.
caption:

headline: Dipu Moni granted 12-hour parole to attend husband's funeral
summary: Former Education Minister Dipu Moni will be released from Munshiganj jail for a brief window to bid farewell to her husband, Tawfique Nawaz, who died after a long illness.
details: Former Education Minister and Awami League Joint General Secretary Dipu Moni has been granted a 12-hour parole to attend the funeral of her husband, Tawfique Nawaz.
The Munshiganj District Magistrate and Deputy Commissioner, Syeda Nurmahal Ashrafi, approved the parole for Thursday, August 20, from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
Tawfique Nawaz passed away on Tuesday night at Continental Hospital in Gulshan, Dhaka, after suffering from long-term kidney and liver complications.
Dipu Moni's lawyer, Gazi Faisal Islam, stated that while they had applied for a four-day parole, the administration granted 12 hours based on prison rules and the District Magistrate's authority.
Dipu Moni is currently detained in Munshiganj District Jail as an accused in several cases related to killings during the July mass uprising.
Under police escort, she will be taken to her residence in Kalabagan, Dhaka, to see her husband's body before the funeral prayers at Azad Mosque in Gulshan and burial at Banani Graveyard.
caption:
A 12-hour window for a final goodbye. Former Education Minister Dipu Moni granted brief parole following her husband's death.

Former Education Minister and Awami League Joint General Secretary Dipu Moni has been granted a 12-hour parole to attend the funeral of her husband, Tawfique Nawaz.

The Munshiganj District Magistrate and Deputy Commissioner, Syeda Nurmahal Ashrafi, approved the parole for Thursday, August 20, from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Tawfique Nawaz passed away on Tuesday night at Continental Hospital in Gulshan, Dhaka, after suffering from long-term kidney and liver complications.

Dipu Moni's lawyer, Gazi Faisal Islam, stated that while they had applied for a four-day parole, the administration granted 12 hours based on prison rules and the District Magistrate's authority.

Dipu Moni is currently detained in Munshiganj District Jail as an accused in several cases related to killings during the July mass uprising.

Under police escort, she will be taken to her residence in Kalabagan, Dhaka, to see her husband's body before the funeral prayers at Azad Mosque in Gulshan and burial at Banani Graveyard.
